title: Once Again from the End
overview: When Jooheon Suh is mortally wounded in battle, a mysterious talking crow gives him another chance.

title: Those Who Seek to Own Relics
overview: Jooheon returns home only to find that a tomb has opened where his apartment used to be.

title: One Suited for Domination
overview: When the tomb housing the Masamune relic appears, Jooheon races to claim it before a foreigner can.

title: The One Who Stole the Future
overview: The Future Guide hints at a powerful relic that will be up for auction in Las Vegas.

title: The Owner of the Tree of Life
overview: Jooheon wins several relics at the Midas auction house, but Chairman Taejoon Kwon wastes no time tracking him down.

title: The Great Tombification
overview: When Kwon tries to use his relic to force Jooheon into submission, its power awakens another set of relics.

title: Restoration of Relics
overview: Jooheon seeks out the aid of a certain individual to restore the relics that broke in his fight against Kwon.

title: The Secret of the Crow
overview: Jooheon is offered a job finding a relic for the "Queen of War," an American military general.

title: The Ruler of Relics
overview: Jooheon pockets the map relic he fetched for General Kiera and makes a plan to destroy her other map relics.

title: The Curse of Relics
overview: An international organization called Pandora is founded to keep relics out of the hands of citizens.
